summary: The registrant, BlackRock Private Credit Fund, filed an 8-K to declare a regular cash distribution for each share class. Institutional shares receive $0.1921 gross/net; Class S shares $0.1921 gross, $0.0167 fee, $0.1754 net; Class D shares $0.1921 gross, $0.0049 fee, $0.1872 net. Record date is April 29, 2026, payable May 27, 2026, in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is routine capital return, not a special situation. No premium, advisor, or board recommendation is specified. The event is standard for a closed-end fund distributing earnings. What to watch: consistency of future distributions relative to net investment income.
